description: Find growing extensions using saved 7/14/30/90-day user or rating-count growth rankings. Candidates have 1K-1M users and at least 500 net new users in the window. Free without a key for the first 10 by 30-day user gain; omit arguments for that preview. Missing comparison data is not zero growth; requests never rebuild rankings.

fastGrowth.description: Free preview does not apply the optional 20% user-growth filter.

page.description: Free preview includes the first page only.

pageSize.description: Free preview returns at most 10 extensions; omit to use this default.

sort.description: Free preview ranks by net user gain, not percentage or rating-count gain.

windowDays.description: Free preview uses the saved 30-day growth window only.

name: extension_trending
